# Candidate static Component contract end-to-end conformance (#621).
# Exact request/response C typedefs are generated by the existing salts-idlc
# ARTIFACTS TYPES implementation, not by this candidate.
set(_cidlc_schema
  "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/databind/compiler/package_config/databind_target/native_contract_service.schema")
salts_idl_target(
  TARGET component_idl_candidate_types
  IDL "${_cidlc_schema}"
  ARTIFACT_NAME component_idl_candidate
  ARTIFACTS TYPES)

add_executable(component_idl_candidate_render emit_fixture.c)
target_link_libraries(component_idl_candidate_render
  PRIVATE Salts::ComponentIdlCandidate)
target_compile_features(component_idl_candidate_render PRIVATE c_std_11)
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_render PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
  FOLDER "component-idl/tests")

set(_cidlc_outdir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(_cidlc_header "${_cidlc_outdir}/calc_component.h")
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT "${_cidlc_header}"
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${_cidlc_outdir}"
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_render>
    "${_cidlc_schema}"
    "WasmRuntime.Calculator"
    "component_idl_candidate_native.h"
    "${_cidlc_header}"
  DEPENDS component_idl_candidate_render "${_cidlc_schema}"
  VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(component_idl_candidate_codegen
  DEPENDS "${_cidlc_header}")

add_executable(component_idl_candidate_static_c11
  static_component_consumer.c "${_cidlc_header}")
add_executable(component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17
  static_component_consumer.cpp "${_cidlc_header}")
foreach(target IN ITEMS
    component_idl_candidate_static_c11
    component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17)
  add_dependencies("${target}" component_idl_candidate_codegen
    component_idl_candidate_types_idl_codegen)
  target_link_libraries("${target}" PRIVATE
    component_idl_candidate_types_types Salts::Component)
  target_include_directories("${target}" PRIVATE "${_cidlc_outdir}")
  set_target_properties("${target}" PROPERTIES
    FOLDER "component-idl/tests")
endforeach()
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_static_c11 PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17 PROPERTIES
  CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_executable(component_idl_candidate_negative
  invalid_component_contract.c)
target_link_libraries(component_idl_candidate_negative
  PRIVATE Salts::ComponentIdlCandidate)
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_negative PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
  FOLDER "component-idl/tests")

add_test(NAME component_idl_candidate_static_c11
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_static_c11>)
add_test(NAME component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17>)
add_test(NAME component_idl_candidate_negative
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_negative>)
foreach(test IN ITEMS
    component_idl_candidate_static_c11
    component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17
    component_idl_candidate_negative)
  set_tests_properties("${test}" PROPERTIES
    LABELS "component-idl;candidate;static")
endforeach()


# P2.0 real provider DSO: compiled from the same canonical IDL TYPES and
# CMeta Component declaration, exported through existing Plugin INTERFACE ABI.
# This does not link the DSO into the host, or add a second runtime.
add_library(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso SHARED
  dso/idl_component_provider.c)
target_compile_features(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso PRIVATE c_std_11)
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
  FOLDER "component-idl/tests/dso")
target_include_directories(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso PRIVATE
  "${_cidlc_outdir}")
target_link_libraries(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso PRIVATE
  component_idl_candidate_types_types
  Salts::ComponentPluginABI Salts::PluginABI)
add_dependencies(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso
  component_idl_candidate_codegen component_idl_candidate_types_idl_codegen)

add_executable(component_idl_candidate_dso_host
  dso/idl_component_host.c)
target_compile_features(component_idl_candidate_dso_host PRIVATE c_std_11)
set_target_properties(component_idl_candidate_dso_host PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF
  FOLDER "component-idl/tests/dso")
target_include_directories(component_idl_candidate_dso_host PRIVATE
  "${_cidlc_outdir}")
target_compile_definitions(component_idl_candidate_dso_host PRIVATE
  "COMPONENT_IDL_DSO_PATH=\"$<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_provider_dso>\"")
target_link_libraries(component_idl_candidate_dso_host PRIVATE
  component_idl_candidate_types_types Salts::ComponentPlugin Salts::Plugin)
add_dependencies(component_idl_candidate_dso_host
  component_idl_candidate_codegen component_idl_candidate_types_idl_codegen
  component_idl_candidate_provider_dso)

add_test(NAME component_idl_candidate_dso_runtime
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_dso_host>)
set_tests_properties(component_idl_candidate_dso_runtime PROPERTIES
  LABELS "component-idl;candidate;dso" TIMEOUT 90)


# P2.1: explicitly generate a SEPARATE canonical Component Provider INTERFACE
# export header from exactly the same admitted IdlContract as the static
# Component and original TYPES. No change to NATIVE/PLUGIN FUNCTION artifacts.
set(_cidlc_plugin_header "${_cidlc_outdir}/calc_component_plugin.h")
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT "${_cidlc_plugin_header}"
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${_cidlc_outdir}"
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:component_idl_candidate_render>
    "${_cidlc_schema}"
    "WasmRuntime.Calculator"
    "calc_component.h"
    "${_cidlc_plugin_header}"
    "--provider-plugin"
  DEPENDS component_idl_candidate_render
          "${_cidlc_schema}" "${_cidlc_header}"
  VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(component_idl_candidate_provider_export_codegen
  DEPENDS "${_cidlc_plugin_header}")
add_dependencies(component_idl_candidate_provider_dso
  component_idl_candidate_provider_export_codegen)
add_dependencies(component_idl_candidate_dso_host
  component_idl_candidate_provider_export_codegen)
add_dependencies(component_idl_candidate_static_cpp17
  component_idl_candidate_provider_export_codegen)
